title: XStack: A Benchmark for ML Repo Migration
why_read: A practical benchmark testing whether AI coding agents can migrate ML codebases between PyTorch/GPU and JAX/TPU ecosystems.
analysis: XStack addresses a real pain point: research code is often locked to one framework and one type of hardware, and porting it correctly is tedious and error-prone. The benchmark grades agents on whether they can take a PyTorch GPU repo and produce a working JAX TPU version that reproduces the original paper's results, with current best agents succeeding only 75% of the time. This gives a concrete, practically grounded way to measure progress on long-horizon coding agent tasks beyond toy benchmarks. Useful for anyone tracking how capable agents are becoming at real software engineering work rather than isolated coding puzzles.
